auth.label: Web API Key
auth.description: FinerWorks web API key. Find it at https://v2.api.finerworks.com/Documentation

extraFields.label: App Key
extraFields.description: FinerWorks app key sent with the app_key header.

actions.name: get_prices
actions.description: Get FinerWorks price breakdowns for one to fifty product codes or inventory SKUs.

product_qty.description: The quantity of this product to price.

product_sku.description: The FinerWorks product code or virtual inventory SKU.

items.description: A product and quantity to price.

products.description: One to fifty products to price.

account_key.description: An optional delegated account key for authorized FinerWorks accounts.

items.description: The FinerWorks price breakdown for one requested product.

prices.description: Price breakdowns for the requested products.

status.description: The status details returned by FinerWorks for the request.

outputSchema.description: The price breakdowns returned by FinerWorks.

actions.name: list_media_types
actions.description: List FinerWorks print media types and their compatible product and style information.

ids.description: Optional IDs used to filter the returned catalog entries.

site_id.description: The optional FinerWorks site ID. The upstream default is 2.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for a FinerWorks media catalog request.

items.description: A FinerWorks media type and its compatible product and style information.

status.description: The status details returned by FinerWorks for the request.

outputSchema.description: The media types returned by FinerWorks.

actions.name: list_product_types
actions.description: List FinerWorks print product types, optionally filtered by product type IDs.

ids.description: Optional IDs used to filter the returned catalog entries.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for a FinerWorks catalog request.

items.description: A FinerWorks product type and its compatible media and printable IDs.

status.description: The status details returned by FinerWorks for the request.

outputSchema.description: The product types returned by FinerWorks.

actions.name: list_style_types
actions.description: List FinerWorks print style types, sizing constraints, and framing options.

ids.description: Optional IDs used to filter the returned catalog entries.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for a FinerWorks catalog request.

items.description: A FinerWorks style type, sizing constraints, and framing options.

status.description: The status details returned by FinerWorks for the request.

outputSchema.description: The style types returned by FinerWorks.
